posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
ZENWARECO said:
There's no like patches to get over 999 stats though for Rm2k? Nothing?
Click to expand...
There is no patch to increase these limit values for one of these reasons:
The editor would also need to be modified.
It may be that certain spaces in the RAM's addresses can break the game when starting.
Rm2k3's RPG_RT.exe was created based on Rm2k but with the original source code I assume, so it was easy to change these limits, so creating a PATCH for this would be quite exhausting due to the various environments in which these values are used, player menu, battle with calculations, curves.
To be honest, most prefer to create their own battle system with events, whether per turn or on the map like Zelda, since the variables have a limit of 999999 and even so I've never seen anyone put values that high except for a specific weapon or final boss.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I believe that your question in the topic has been resolved since it is not possible to legally modify RPG2000 and you have already migrated to RPG2003.
About RPG2003 PATCHs, I recommend that you read this:
Rules - RPG Maker 2003 - Patch EULA
The EULA for patches for RPG Maker 2003 is finally available!  Please download it and take a look:  Click here to download  This EULA is in two parts - one section is for pack users and another for pack creators. Though patches that conform to the EULA are officially recognized and allowed...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
You will notice that official support is only for the unmodified version, this probably extends to the forum, otherwise there would be several topics about MANIACS. I recommend looking for groups on Reddit or Discord about the subject, in particular I do not use PATCHs because I prefer to develop systems with events, so I have no experience in the subject.
We also avoid turning it into a chat room about similar thread that are not really related to the title thread.
Good luck
